keyFindings.description: Security[authz]: with requireCookieSignIn removed, a cookie-identity server with no DISPATCH_SIGNIN_* and no dev sign-in builds identity.CookieIdentity{SigningKey, Sessions} with Membership nil, so CookieIdentity.Login (internal/dispatch/identity/identity.go:42-62) accepts every dsession cookie signed with the persistent DISPATCH_SIGNING_KEY for its 30-day life with no membership confirmation. A stack that drops its sign-in inputs (D3 allows tailnet set + sign-in unset; D7's lost-settings case) keeps every earlier browser session live, including for a person since removed from the domain, who can still mint non-expiring personal tokens. Fix: when cookie mode has no sign-in flow and !boot.DevSignIn, refuse every cookie (leave Sessions nil, which Login already turns into ErrNoIdentity, or a refusing identity); add a test that mints a cookie with the deployment key, boots with no sign-in and expects 401; correct identity.go:34-35 and the READMEs that say only that nobody signs in.

dispatchNamedInputs picks the two groups out of dispatchClusterOnlyRefusals by string name and panics on a miss; the test side repeats the loop and panic (dispatch_cluster_only_test.go dispatchNamedRefusals) and writes the group lists a second time (dispatch_sandbox_test.go:231-236), so the 'one definition' comments (dispatch.go:667, dispatch_sandbox_test.go:239, dispatch_construct_test.go:527) are false. Fix: literal dispatchTailnetInputs/dispatchSignInInputs rows, the cluster-only table built with slices.Concat of them and the rest; same in the tests; delete both selectors and the panics.

The front door is built behind four separate `if s.frontDoor` gates, with zero-value carriers (authKeySecret, frontDoorPod, frontDoorOpts) and the Deployment's comment now detached above a bare `//` at :519. Registration order is free (dispatchRegistrations sorts), so build the auth-key Secret, newDispatchFrontDoor, the Deployment, the 1055 Service and the front-door policy in one block (or inside newDispatchFrontDoor); only the app-ingress rule keeps its own gate.

A refusal of a set-but-malformed input in a half-set group (tailnetDnsName 'bad' alone, a bad tag, signInDomain 'Example.com' with the secret unset) carries no unset list, against the README/PR claim that one run names the whole shortfall. Fold dispatchGroupUnset into dispatchGroupClause(feature, group), compute each clause once as a string, append it whenever the group has an unset input, and drop the set parameter and the two closures.

No test renders the combination D3 keeps allowed, tailnet group set and sign-in group unset: add one registration test asserting the front door is built, the app carries no DISPATCH_SIGNIN_* and the Secret has no DISPATCH_SIGNIN_CLIENT_SECRET.

readDispatchSandboxURL repeats runDispatchWithProviders' provider setup only to await Url, which TestConstructDispatchSandbox already checks; the construct test re-lists the front-door names dispatchSandboxFrontDoor already holds.
noSignInEnvironment builds the full sign-in environment then blanks it; the no-sign-in boot check is repeated in main_test.go, signin_off_test.go and settings_test.go.

Prose the change made false: cookie identity no longer requires the sign-in settings at startup; DISPATCH_SERVER_URL is the sign-in callback origin only where sign-in is configured; signInRule/signInFlow are nil for cookie identity with no sign-in too; Membership is nil on more than the dev sign-in server. Bundled with the authz fix because their wording depends on it.
